claims: In February 2023, customers spent $329.47 on sports video games.
In March 2023, customers spent $171.06 on sports video games.
The second La Liga Clásico of the 2022/2023 season between Barcelona and Real Madrid was played in March 2023.
Spending on sports video games decreased by 48.08% in March 2023 compared to February 2023.
